texto_original: Let me rear for a moment, Altair. William of Montferrat has replaced many of the district's honest merchants with men loyal to his cause. He seeks to weaken faith in King Richard by overcharging honest citizens for poorly crafted goods. These corrupt merchants must be removed. Find their stands and destroy them.
traducao_ptbr: Deixe-me respirar um instante, Altair. William de Montferrat substituiu muitos dos comerciantes honestos do distrito por homens leais à sua causa. Ele tenta enfraquecer a fé no Rei Ricardo cobrando caro demais de cidadãos honestos por mercadorias mal feitas. Esses comerciantes corruptos devem ser eliminados. Encontre as barracas deles e destrua-as.
